# willfish/mux compatibility fixtures

These fixtures are vendored verbatim from
[`willfish/mux`](https://github.com/willfish/mux) at commit
[`927030bb88e4b16b6671f68610980491ffbd2c81`](https://github.com/willfish/mux/tree/927030bb88e4b16b6671f68610980491ffbd2c81):

- `detach.yml` through `window_root.yml` come from
  [`tests/fixtures`](https://github.com/willfish/mux/tree/927030bb88e4b16b6671f68610980491ffbd2c81/tests/fixtures).
- `demo.yml` comes from
  [`demo/demo.yml`](https://github.com/willfish/mux/blob/927030bb88e4b16b6671f68610980491ffbd2c81/demo/demo.yml).

The source repository declares the project MIT-licensed in its
[`README.md`](https://github.com/willfish/mux/blob/927030bb88e4b16b6671f68610980491ffbd2c81/README.md#license).
Its fixture-introduction commit
[`940b08c0853f2578adfffd86a8fa5efb28c4a217`](https://github.com/willfish/mux/commit/940b08c0853f2578adfffd86a8fa5efb28c4a217)
states that the test data is based on the tmuxinator Ruby gem test suite.
